title: Billy Quit his Job to Start an AI App Agency: Here's How
channel: Chris Koerner on The Koerner Office Podcast
promo_conflict: Billy says he is not sponsored by Replit, but promotes it and says a Replit CEO retweet helped his posts reach a much larger audience (L0500-L0507).

idea.name: Custom app agency
idea.one_liner: Build simple custom apps for businesses and startups, with custom projects and ongoing app operation as a revenue model.
idea.customer: Business owners and startups, including niche B2B companies.
idea.offer: Custom internal apps, dashboards and API-connected tools built with AI coding tools.
idea.revenue_model: Custom app work and, in at least one example, a monthly fee to run the app; exact general pricing not stated.

key_quotes.quote: I make stupid simple apps for business owners and startups.
I can make really useful internal apps for my clients without taking too much of my day up
Now I run an app agency and I've got a team of four guys.

claims.claim: A Replit bounty could cost $150 for three hours of developer time.
claims.quote: you could pay like 150 bucks to get three hours of dev time from I think a pool of like agencies they work with.

claims.claim: Developers told him finishing the final 10% of his code could take as long as rebuilding it from scratch.
claims.quote: it' be quicker rather it would take the same time to do that last 10% from your code than for me to just do it from scratch

claims.claim: A niche B2B app might only have one or two users.
claims.quote: for really niche things where one or two people are going to use it

claims.claim: A custom app could let a company pay for one SaaS seat instead of 20 and pull the data into its own app.
claims.quote: why would anyone pay for 20 seats on whatever SAS when they could pay for one and then have a C custom app built that just pulls all that data in and out for them

acquisition_channels.details: Billy says he found an initial app client through Upwork.
Posting app-building videos on Twitter and YouTube brought inbound interest.
He says he is optimizing for relationship-based B2B sales.

ideas.delivery: Billy and a small team build and operate custom apps; client data, security and the final production work need human oversight.

prices: $150 for three hours of developer time

ideas.other_uk_rules: UK GDPR and processor terms may apply when client apps handle personal data.
